title: At Made by Google, Trevor Noah explains how Gemini is just like GLP-1s
excerpt: Gemini, now fully integrated into Pixel phones, was the star of the show at Made by Google.
content_html:
Made By Google is here, which means smarter phones, fancier watches, and even more AI.

Ahead of the event, Google announced that its AI assistant hit more than one billion monthly users. It's not just brand loyalty either, with more than 100 million of those querists turning to the app from iOS devices. Gemini now generates more than 150 million images every day, according to the company, and more than half of Gemini's users speak directly to their AI helper rather than relying on text.

It's the fastest-growing Google product of all time, according to the tech giant.

So it makes sense that Google would start the event — and spend a majority of host Trevor Noah's time — talking about Gemini Intelligence.

Gemini Intelligence on the Pixel 11

Google is banking on making Gemini a genuinely "useful" AI assistant, what Noah ironically likened to the mass adoption of GLP-1s. "They take things off of your plate," he joked during the event's talk-show format. Later, Noah said that previous iterations of Google's AI were more like a "cool promise" than anything people would use in their everyday life.

Mashable Light Speed

Credit: John Nacion/Variety via Getty Images

And Google agreed.

The solution, in the company's eyes, is to upgrade Pixel phones with even more native Gemini Intelligence features. That includes enhanced live translation for podcasts, YouTube videos, and third party apps (the feature was introduced for phone calls last year) and a major AI accessibility upgrade with ASL-to-text.

Google also announced the new Rambler feature, a Pixel phone feature that automatically filters out filler words, cleans up sentences, and "reads" a user's intent to produce a more streamlined speech-to-text experience.

And the company revamped its existing Magic Cue feature into the new Proactive Assistance interface. Proactive Assistance generates automatic context, suggestions, informational windows, and even responses to information found in messages. If your friend recommends a new restaurant, for example, Proactive Assistance will pull up its reviews, menu, and even directions.

Gemini on smartwatches

Many of these features are also integrated into Google's Pixel watch line, including one-tap Proactive Assistance queues and new Google Health Guardian features, including the AI-powered Google Health Coach. Pixel Watch users can also use Gemini directly from their wrist with At a Glance.

The goal, the company said, is to let Gemini do the rote tasks (including texting your friends) so you can step away from the screen. You just have to buy the latest model and keep your phone on you at all times, of course.

content_html_zh:
Made By Google 已经到来，这意味着更智能的手机、更精美的手表，甚至更多的人工智能。

活动开始前，谷歌宣布其人工智能助手月用户数超过 10 亿。 这也不仅仅是品牌忠诚度，超过 1 亿的查询者从 iOS 设备转向该应用程序。 据该公司称，Gemini 现在每天生成超过 1.5 亿张图像，超过一半的 Gemini 用户直接与人工智能助手对话，而不是依赖文本。

据科技巨头谷歌称，这是有史以来增长最快的谷歌产品。

因此，谷歌发起这次活动并在主持人特雷弗·诺亚 (Trevor Noah) 的大部分时间里谈论 Gemini Intelligence 是有道理的。

Pixel 11 上的 Gemini Intelligence

谷歌希望将 Gemini 打造成真正“有用”的人工智能助手，诺亚讽刺地将其比作 GLP-1 的大规模采用。 “他们会把你的事情从你的盘子里拿走，”他在活动的脱口秀形式中开玩笑说。 后来，诺亚表示，谷歌人工智能的先前迭代更像是一个“很酷的承诺”，而不是人们在日常生活中使用的任何东西。

可混搭光速

图片来源：John Nacion/Variety via Getty Images

谷歌同意了。

该公司认为，解决方案是升级 Pixel 手机，使其具有更多原生 Gemini Intelligence 功能。 其中包括增强的播客、YouTube 视频和第三方应用程序的实时翻译（该功能于去年针对电话通话引入），以及通过 ASL 到文本进行的重大 AI 辅助功能升级。

谷歌还宣布了新的 Rambler 功能，这是 Pixel 手机的一项功能，可以自动过滤掉填充词、清理句子并“读取”用户的意图，从而产生更简化的语音转文本体验。

该公司还将其现有的 Magic Cue 功能改进为新的主动协助界面。 主动协助会自动生成上下文、建议、信息窗口，甚至对消息中的信息做出响应。 例如，如果您的朋友推荐一家新餐厅，主动协助将调出其评论、菜单，甚至路线。

智能手表上的双子座

其中许多功能也集成到 Google 的 Pixel 手表系列中，包括一键主动协助队列和新的 Google Health Guardian 功能，包括人工智能驱动的 Google Health Coach。 Pixel Watch 用户还可以通过 At a Glance 直接从手腕使用 Gemini。

该公司表示，目标是让 Gemini 完成死记硬背的任务（包括给朋友发短信），这样你就可以远离屏幕了。 当然，您只需购买最新型号并始终随身携带手机即可。
